reference:
The Lex Antonia, established in ancient Rome in April 44 BC, was a law proposed by Mark Antony and passed by the Roman Senate, formally abolishing the Dictatorship. This law was the second to abolish the Dictatorship, with the first being passed after the Second Punic War, but it had been essentially nullified by the subsequent Dictatorships of Sulla and Caesar. 

FINDING: Lex Antonia nullified the dictatorial laws set up by Sulla.
